s.es: gestiona las interfaces de red a nivel de enlace

syn: ip link { COMMAND | help } ⏎ ip link add [ link DEVICE ] [ name ] NAME ⏎ [ txqueuelen PACKETS ] ⏎ [ address LLADDR ] [ broadcast LLADDR ] ⏎ [ mtu MTU ] [ index IDX ] ⏎ [ numtxqueues QUEUE_COUNT ] [ numrxqueues QUEUE_COUNT ]

set.es: Cambia propiedades: up/down, mtu, name, address, promisc on/off…
set.en: Change properties: up/down, mtu, name, address, promisc on/off…

add.es: Crea una interfaz virtual (bridge, vlan, veth…).
